language.name: English
welcome.title: Let’s build a set
welcome.text: Open a folder with tracks. The app detects the tempo, key and energy of every track and suggests an order in which they mix smoothly.
scan.label: Analysis
bench.title: Out of the set
set.hint: Drag tracks with the mouse. A lock keeps a track in place when the set is rebuilt. The curve and priorities are on the Tools tab.
set.all_benched: Every track has been removed from the set — bring them back from the list below.
set.no_tracks: This folder has no FLAC, MP3 or WAV tracks.
mix.title: Cues and transitions
mix.text: Points on the downbeats of each track’s beat grid: where to start the next track, where to swap the bass and when to take the previous one out. Times are from the start of the file; bars count from the first downbeat.
mix.how.title: How to bring the cues into Rekordbox
mix.how.auto: Automatically. On the Export tab, turn on “Mix cues” and import the Rekordbox XML: the grid and cues A–E arrive with the tracks. Rekordbox may keep the cues of tracks it has already analysed — then set them by hand.
mix.how.manual: By hand. Turn on Quantize. Open the track, stop playback at the given time (zoom into the waveform; the counter shows min:sec.ms) and press a free Hot Cue button — the cue snaps to the nearest beat.
mix.how.grid: Check the grid. Rekordbox’s first beat must match the “first beat” in the table below. If Rekordbox starts the bar on a different beat, shift its grid — otherwise the bar numbers drift apart, although the cue times stay correct.
mix.one: The set has one track — no transitions.
mix.no_grid: One of the tracks has no beat grid — mix this transition by ear.
mix.step2: Bass swap: in “{0}” this is {1}, bar {2}
cue.precision_title: Typical distance of single hits from the grid
curves.title: Energy curve
curves.text: The shape of the night. Building fits both the track energy and the tempo to the curve.
curve.rise.name: Ramp-up
curve.rise.description: A calm start, a climb to the peak near the end and a short breather at the finish.
curve.arc.name: Arc
curve.arc.description: Peak in the middle with a soft start and finish. For a mid-evening set.
curve.waves.name: Waves
curve.waves.description: Rises and breathers over a general climb — the dance floor gets to catch its breath.
curve.plateau.name: Plateau
curve.plateau.description: A quick climb to high energy and a steady drive to the end.
curve.cooldown.name: Cool-down
curve.cooldown.description: From the peak to a calm finish — to close the night.
weights.title: Build priorities
weights.text: What matters more when not everything fits.
slot.title: Timed set
slot.text: Picks the best tracks from the whole folder to fit the slot.
slot.need_minutes: Enter the slot length in minutes
slot.result: {0} of {1} tracks made it in, ≈ {2} when mixed.
next.title: What to play next
next.text: The best follow-ups for the selected track and where they sit on the Camelot wheel.
next.wheel: Outer ring: major (B); inner ring: minor (A). The number in a sector is how many tracks of the folder are in that key. Keys that mix with the selected one are outlined.
next.shift: Energy relative to the current track
checks.title: Transition check
checks.text: Places where mixing will need attention.
checks.too_few: The set has fewer than two tracks.
octave.title: Tempo octave
octave.text: The analyser can’t always tell 70 from 140 BPM. Tell it which range your genre lives in.
export.title: Write the set into the files
export.text: The order ends up in the files themselves — Rekordbox, Serato and any player will see it without this app.
export.name: Set name
export.rename.hint: “07 - Artist - Title.flac”. Tracks out of the set lose their old numbers.
export.tags.hint: Title “07 Title”, album: the set name, track number. Rekordbox sorts by these fields. FLAC and MP3 only.
export.bpmkey.hint: For software without its own analysis.
export.cues.hint: A cue sheet “… — cues.txt” in the set folder, and in Rekordbox XML the beat grid and cues A–E (hot cues and memory cues).
export.xml.hint: A playlist with the order, BPM and key. To connect it: Preferences → Advanced → Database → rekordbox xml, then in the tree rekordbox xml → Playlists → Import Playlist.
export.done: The set is written into the files
log.title: Log
log.text: What was done during the last write.
restore.title: Undo
restore.text: Before the first write, the app saves the original names and tags to .prodj-backup.json in the set folder.
restore.confirm: Restore the original names and tags? Click again
restore.done: The files are back as they were
player.no_grid: This transition has no beat grid
player.transition: Transition {0} → {1} by the cues; the bass swaps on the downbeat
volume.label: Volume
toast.rebuilt_curve: The set was rebuilt for the “{0}” curve
toast.rebuilt_weights: The set was rebuilt with the new priorities
toast.octave: Tempo recalculated for the new range
advice.tempo_and_clash: A big tempo jump and a key clash — better move the track or cut hard on a break.
advice.tempo_jump: The tempo changes by {0}% — go through a break, an echo-out or a hard cut.
advice.clash: The keys clash — mix on the drums and don’t layer the melodies.
advice.tempo_shift: A noticeable tempo change — bring it in early or stretch the transition.
advice.boost: Moving up a key gives an audible energy lift — good before a drop.
note.pitch_far: The tempo differs by {0}% — too much for a long blend: better a short cut on a break or an echo-out.
note.pitch_near: The tempo differs by {0}% — adjust it in advance, before the transition starts.
sheet.title: ProDJ Tools — mix cues: {0}
sheet.time_note: Times are from the start of the file (min:sec.ms). Bar 1 is the first downbeat in the file.
sheet.quantize: In Rekordbox, turn on Quantize: the cue lands exactly on a beat of the grid.
sheet.no_grid_pair: one of the tracks has no grid — mix by ear
sheet.step1: in “{0}”, start “{1}” from cue A · MIX IN ({2})
sheet.step2: bass swap — in “{0}” this is {1}, bar {2}
export.log.backup: Original names and tags saved to {0}
export.log.unnumbered: Tracks out of the set lost their old numbers: {0}
export.no_backup: There is no backup in this folder
export.restore_failed: Files not restored: {0}. The backup is kept.
picker.title: Folder with tracks for the set
picker.windows_only: The folder dialog is only available on Windows — paste the path instead
error.track_gone: Track not found — open the folder again
error.wait_scan: Wait for the analysis to finish
error.bpm_floor: The lower tempo bound must be between 50 and 120 BPM
